title: feat: add ElevenLabs TTS timestamps
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `POST /v1/audio/speech/with-timestamps` to the three existing ElevenLabs TTS models.
- Returns base64 audio plus original and normalized character alignment.
- Keeps direct ElevenLabs routing, paid-only access, multiplier 1, and current prices unchanged.
- Supports MP3, Opus, AAC, WAV, and PCM; FLAC is rejected because ElevenLabs would return PCM.
- Uses no Pollinations GPU or fallback and bills exact input characters.
- Encodes custom voice IDs and publishes the timestamp endpoint in model metadata.

Validation:
- Live E2E: v3/MP3, Flash/WAV, Multilingual v2/Opus; exact deductions 0.0013 / 0.00065 / 0.0013 Pollen.
- Live WAV RIFF/data sizes and ffprobe playback verified.
- 7 focused timestamp tests, Gen/Enter typechecks, and Enter pricing snapshot pass.

Stacked on #12778 to avoid duplicating endpoint-scoping and voice-ID hardening.

### Endpoint-gating follow-up (2026-07-26)

- Fixed the standard TTS routing regression introduced by endpoint metadata: generic audio defaults now include both /audio/{text} and /v1/audio/speech, and both routes pass their exact endpoint identity.
- Added route-level coverage for explicit elevenlabs, omitted/default model, and the simple GET route; all return 200.
- Latest stacked Gen verification: typecheck clean, paid modality E2E clean, and 694/694 tests across 74 files pass.
- Documented the measured 12 credits/second audio-input metering and its Scale-plan reconciliation in code.
- CI follow-up: the deterministic route test now injects a test-only provider key through the Worker environment; the secretless GitHub suite passes.

gist.headline: Every syllable gets a pin
gist.blurb: ElevenLabs voices can now leave little timestamps along the trail. Your audio arrives with character-level alignment, so words and waveforms can finally agree on where they are.
gist.summary: Added POST /v1/audio/speech/with-timestamps for all three ElevenLabs TTS models, returning base64 audio plus original and normalized character alignment for MP3, Opus, AAC, WAV, and PCM output.
gist.impact: Builders can now synchronize captions, highlighted text, and audio playback against ElevenLabs speech while keeping existing direct routing, paid access, and per-character billing.
gist.visual_concept: Depict ElevenLabs speech as a cozy audio waveform growing through a garden, with each spoken character marked by a tiny timestamp flag. Polli should be carefully placing pins along the waveform like a patient sound editor, while a friendly CRT monitor displays aligned text and an audio timeline; include flowers and code-plants to show that precise timing is now part of the API.
